visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female vendor wearing a red apron over a white t-shirt and a white face mask is seen from the chest up. Her hands are covered in clear plastic gloves as she holds a large metal cleaver to chop a whole smoked goose on a dark, circular wooden cutting board. The background shows a storefront with white window frames and a green scooter parked outside. (2) An extreme close-up focuses on a slice of pinkish-red smoked meat held by wooden chopsticks. The meat appears juicy with a glistening dark brown skin. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a street sidewalk where a queue of about five people is waiting. A man in a black t-shirt stands in the foreground, and others in various casual clothes and helmets wait under a green awning. A white and green scooter is parked prominently on the right. (4) Back to the vendor's hands, she expertly slices the meat into thin, uniform strips on the wooden board. Clear plastic containers are ready on the green-covered table. (5) A clear plastic takeout container is shown filled with neatly arranged slices of smoked meat and a small wedge of lime. A hand uses chopsticks to lift a slice, demonstrating its tenderness. (6) A hand holds up three small plastic packets containing brown sauce and pepper-salt seasoning against a blurred outdoor background. (7) Close-up shots of smoked goose wings and dark, rectangular pieces of pig's blood cake are shown. The rice cake has a sticky, sauce-covered texture and is lifted with chopsticks to show its consistency. (8) The final scene shows the vendor's stall sign which includes text and images of food. A woman with a ponytail walks past the camera in a blurred street setting while a large text overlay appears with the shop's name and address.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and promote a popular smoked goose stall in Kaohsiung. It uses visual cues of fresh preparation, appetizing close-ups, and evidence of customer popularity (the queue) combined with energetic narration to entice viewers to visit.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video includes specific location information, shop name, and a direct recommendation to visit.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency cuts and appetizing macro shots typical of short-form social media food reviews. The audio-visual sync of the chopping sounds adds a tactile sense of freshness.
